title: two files of one module may not both declare main
purpose: Multi-file modules share one declaration space with at most one main.

rejection.justification: spec 5.1: the combined module MUST NOT declare more than one main; the stage is not fixed.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 5.1: every file declares the same module and the combined module MUST NOT declare more than one main.
